# EclipseTone Productions

> Music production studio in Montréal, Québec, working online with independent artists anywhere. One team for an artist's song, music video, CDs and USB-C cards, website and social media. Every instrument is played by real musicians; no AI-generated music.

- Location: Montréal, QC, Canada. Works remotely worldwide; in-person studio recording in Montréal.
- Languages: English and French.
- Contact: WhatsApp or phone +1 438 466 8971. Start a project: https://eclipsetone.com/#start
- Prices are in Canadian dollars. Clients in Canada pay GST and QST on top; clients outside Canada don't.
- Payment: nothing to start. Once the client approves the price, half to start and half before the final files.
- Ownership: the client owns the finished song, beat and vocals once paid, in writing.
- Speed: first version in 7 days, finished song in 2 to 3 weeks.

## Prices

- Mixing: from $150 CAD per song
- Studio recording (2 hours in person, Montréal, with coaching, vocal production and the mix): $350 CAD
- Full Song (production from the artist's vocals or lyrics, mix and master): $599 CAD
- Song + Songwriting: $997 CAD
- 3-Song EP: $1,597 CAD
- Song + Launch (release plan, promo assets, launch-week support): $2,000 CAD
- CDs and USB-C cards: from $249 CAD
- Artist website: from $500 CAD
- Music video and social media management: priced per project
